tasks.title: Give the chat Work panel its own JSON task feed
tasks.notes: New GET /changes/{id}/tasks[?task=] JSON endpoint (internal/server/server.go: tasksFeed/tasksFeedRow views, root or one-container scope, subtask rollups, detail hrefs). app.js rewritten off board DOM: renderTaskPanel renders the feed grouped by mirrored model.TaskStatusOrder with rollup markers + scope row; loadSessionTasks fetches the JSON feed; setChatTasks(feed) reshaped; SSE refresh keeps scope via sessionTasksTask; board afterSwap/openChat paths re-pull the feed. Tests: TestTasksFeedRoot/Scope/Errors pass; TestChatCompactWorkUIContract re-pinned to the feed mechanism; go vet ./... clean; go test ./... all packages ok. Live check: built binary served this repo on 127.0.0.1:9099 — /changes/2026-09-24-ic3l8/tasks returned all six UI tasks with hrefs, ?task=UI-00 returned scope metadata with empty children, and the embedded app.js carries the new /tasks fetch; no board-fragment request remains on the Work panel path.

tasks.title: Add a Sessions sheet to the chat options menu with change actions
tasks.notes: Sessions quick action (#chat-sessions-btn, hidden until change-bound like Plan/Tasks — gated in setChatTasks) opens #chat-sessions-sheet, a full data-chat-view panel wired through the view machinery: syncChatView/closeChatView/closeTopChatAuxiliary/requestChatAuxiliary/compactQuery all sessions-aware; header and location labels include Sessions. Sheet renders change sessions (switch via markOpened+openChat, unlink DELETE, New session POST, live-dim, from-badges, task chips), the spawn-change handoff flow (picker from GET /handoffs, POST /spawn-change, opens the spawned session), and the change-actions footer: overall pill, worktree pills (branch/dirty/missing/PR/review link into #detail) from the change JSON, Commit with commit-status poll, Close change with open-task confirm (root tasks from the new feed; server gate stays authoritative), Reopen, Remove worktree (server 422/409 surfaced). All board-change actions parameterized by resolved change (sheetChange()), no longer reading the board. New TestChatSessionsSheetContract pins shell/script/CSS; TestExpandableLocationBreadcrumbContract and TestChatAccessibilityContract label pins extended for sessions. go vet clean; go test ./... all ok. Live check on rebuilt binary: page carries the sheet shell (3 markers), embedded app.js has loadSessionsSheet, /changes/{id}/sessions returns the bound session, change JSON carries overall+worktree for the footer. Revision on user review: the spawn-change handoff picker was removed from the Sessions sheet (button, form, error element, initSheetSpawnChange, spawn CSS overrides). The flow stays agent-driven: POST /changes/{id}/spawn-change and GET /changes/{id}/handoffs remain live API endpoints taught by the workflow prime — deliberate parity with the API-only POST /changes form. Sessions sheet now carries: session list (switch/new/unlink, task chips, from-badges, live dimming), New session, and the change-actions footer (Commit + status poll, Close/Reopen with open-task confirm, worktree pills/remove/review). TestChatSessionsSheetContract updated: spawn shell/script pins removed and a negative pin asserts the spawn UI stays gone. go vet clean; go test ./... all ok; node --check clean; build OK; restarted server serves the sheet without any chat-spawn markup (0 matches).

tasks.title: Add Resume session to the breadcrumb location menu
tasks.notes: Shared resume helper resumeChangeSession(change): continue last-opened session (tt-last-session:<change> validated against the live list, via new markOpenedFor), else newest created, else create+open via createChangeSessionFor; opening the already-active session is a no-op. Breadcrumb dropdown gains a .location-resume action row at the bottom whenever the trail carries a change crumb; label flips Resume/Start session from the sessions payload (updateResumeLabel on menu open). Change crumb model per plan: locationBaseTrail serves the change crumb from sessionStorage context (tt-change-context, set on board pages, in loadSessionTasks with the real change title, and by resume) whenever no chat is open or the open session is bound to that change — so the change name is the current location for bound sessions and the re-entry point when the chat closes, while unbound discussions keep Changes / Chat. activateLocation treats the change crumb as enter-in-place: bound chat open returns to the main chat view (back chevron from panels), otherwise resumes the session; the Changes crumb keeps its / navigation. Contract test extended (resumeChangeSession, data-resume-change, updateResumeLabel, setChangeContext, tt-change-context, markOpenedFor pins) and passes. go vet clean; go test ./... all ok; node --check on app.js clean; rebuilt binary embeds the wiring (7 marker matches in served app.js). Revision on user review: with a plan/task document open above Chat, breadcrumb activation was a no-op behind the modal — the change-crumb branch reset chat views but never closed #detail, so the conversation was unreachable except via the Changes crumb (which reloads and kills the chat). Fix: activateLocation closes an open detail modal first on the change-crumb path (and the back chevron that targets it); closeDetail restores the pre-open trail and refocuses the opener, landing the user back in the conversation. The modal back chevron and Escape keep working. Contract test pins the fix (Back-from-a-doc close-first marker in the change branch). Also removed the visit-persisted change context (tt-change-context/sessionStorage) per the stale-breadcrumb report: the change crumb now exists only while that change session is open, so returning to Changes shows just Changes. go vet clean; go test ./... all ok; node --check clean; build OK; restarted server serves the fixed app.js (marker verified).

tasks.title: Redesign the changes list as mobile cards with tap-to-resume
tasks.notes: index.html replaces the 7-column table with .change-card anchors showing exactly name, status pill, x/y task count (Complete/Tasks), and updated date — no visible ID/prefix, no per-row Plan button. Cards carry data-change plus the sort keys (data-tasks, data-status-rank via statusRank, data-updated, data-title). Sorting moved to a compact #change-sort select (five fixed orders) persisting col:dir in tt-index-sort; corrupt/unknown values fail open to newest-first. Tap-to-resume: plain left clicks on a card call resumeChangeSession (modified clicks keep link semantics; href still deep-links to /changes/{id}). In-place SSE refresh: scheduleRefresh on the index now calls refreshChangeCards() (GET / JSON -> buildChangeCard DOM -> re-apply sort) instead of location.reload(), so an open chat is never interrupted; scaffold-follow behavior unchanged. CSS: table block replaced by card styles (stacked on mobile, auto-fill grid ≥841px) plus the .change-sort control. TestIndexSortableMarkup rewritten to pin the new contract (sort select, card keys/fields, legacy table absent). go vet clean; go test ./... all ok; node --check clean. Live check on rebuilt binary: served index has 238 card/sort markers, zero legacy table markers; index JSON carries id/title/status/updated/tasks/complete for the refresh path.

tasks.title: Remove the kanban board and reroute /changes/{id}
tasks.notes: Board removed end to end. Deleted web/templates/board.html and the boardFragment define; renderer dropped its board template set; layout.html board-page conditionals removed (location nav, #detail, active states now index-only). Server: GET /changes/{id} HTML and HX requests 302 to /?change=<id> preserving ?session= (task param intentionally dropped — subtask scope lives in the Work panel); JSON boardResponse survives unchanged for API clients; POST /changes HX-Redirect now targets /?change=<id>. Client: initSortable, refreshBoard, the board afterSwap handler, boardSessions/task-scoped resume keys, board sessions panel/spawn/continue/lifecycle functions and countOpenTasks all removed; openChat always resolves the change binding via the JSON feed; task status changes refresh the Work feed in place. Decompose rehomed to the task detail modal (data-decompose, POST /expand, 409 lands on subtasks); sub-task deep opens resume first then scope the panel. Index honors ?change=<id>[&session=] via initChangeDeepLink (context seeded, exact session reconnected); followSession targets the new deep link. SortableJS unvendored (file, script tag, VENDOR.md, TestStaticAssets) and board-only CSS blocks removed; sessions sheet reuses the shared worktree pill styles with data-review coloring restored. Tests: TestBoardHTML/TestBoardFragmentHX rewritten as redirect pins; TestBoardLifecycleButtons superseded by TestChatSessionsSheetContract; TestNestedBoardMarkup now pins Decompose/View-subtasks mutual exclusion in the task modal; TestBoardDrillDown pins the HTML redirect plus JSON scope; TestFormEncodedCreateChangeRedirect and TestWorktreeStripOnBoard updated (worktree assertions moved to the JSON payload the sheet renders). go vet clean; go test ./... all ok. Live: HTML/HX/session deep links all 302 to the right targets, JSON API intact, /static/Sortable.min.js 404, tasks feed 200.
